author: Fkn_Kaine
body:
It's immune to everything except dragon. In order to defeat it you need Dragon dmg, Omnimancy or elementless spells🧙‍♂️\
Ancient Dragon can defeat it Mighty Griffin and Hati too however you'd need GS Auriga for them to choose the right move.\
You may also get some mag and use mentioned spells such as Transference or Bloopact.
